{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Copy/paste this job script into a text file and submit with the command:
#    flux submit thefilename
# job standard output will go to a file like flux-job-ID.out

#SBATCH --time=216:00:00   # walltime limit (HH:MM:SS)
#FLUX --time=216:00:00

#SBATCH --nodes=1   # number of nodes
#FLUX --nodes=1

# NOTE: The original SLURM script requested 16 tasks to run a single, multi-threaded
# application. This has been translated to 1 task with 16 CPUs, which is a more
# direct and efficient way to request resources for a threaded workload.
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=16   # 16 processor core(s) per node
#FLUX --ntasks-per-node=1
#FLUX --cpus-per-task=16

#SBATCH --mem=50G   # maximum memory per node
#FLUX --mem-per-node=50G

#SBATCH --job-name="phyluce_trinity_aj"
#FLUX --job-name="phyluce_trinity_aj"

# NOTE: The --mail-user and --mail-type directives have been omitted as Flux
# does not have a direct equivalent for job status email notifications.
#SBATCH --mail-user=kevinq@iastate.edu   # email address
#SBATCH --mail-type=END
#SBATCH --mail-type=FAIL

# LOAD MODULES, INSERT CODE, AND RUN YOUR PROGRAMS HERE
source activate phyluce162

module unuse /opt/rit/spack-modules/lmod/linux-rhel7-x86_64/Core
module use /opt/rit/modules

module load java/1.7.0_55
module load bowtie/1.1.2


phyluce_assembly_assemblo_trinity \
    --conf /ptmp/kevinq/assembly_conf/assembly_Feb2020_aj.conf \
    --output /ptmp/kevinq/trinity-assemblies \
    --log /ptmp/kevinq/logs \
    --clean \
    --cores 16
"
}
